business_problem: Nortura needed a multilingual HR support channel that could answer employee questions around the clock for office and factory workers without compromising data security or answer quality.
solution_summary: Nortura and Capgemini turned the company's HR handbook into Nora, a multilingual generative-AI assistant available on laptops and mobile devices 24/7. The implementation started with a demo and then loaded the full HR handbook so the chatbot could answer policy questions, interpret tables, handle follow-up questions, and link users directly to the relevant handbook pages. Capgemini and Nortura ran several super-user test phases, updated handbook content continuously, and tuned the assistant's tone so responses stayed polite, consistent, and aligned with company policy. The rollout emphasized change management and accessibility for factory and office workers with different language backgrounds, while public-data labeling and compliance controls protected sensitive information. After launch, the team extended the same architecture with health, safety, and environment data in Nora 2.0.
